script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of executer.
Return not (this state → countup-snippet → get with (arg, "currBattlePhaseTurn") is at most the numeric entry "death_turns_staying_on_phase_1" in aiArg) and call game:ai.stateSnippet.HpRateTransition.helper.shouldChangeBattlePhase.apply with (this state, arguments).
